Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the angle from \(OB\) to \(OA\) along the left semicircle is \(180^\circ\).

The shaded sector’s central angle is therefore
\[
180^\circ-40^\circ-45^\circ=95^\circ.
\]

For a point chosen uniformly from the disk, the probability equals the ratio of the shaded area to the disk’s area. A sector occupies the same fraction of the area as its angle occupies of \(360^\circ\):

\[
P=\frac{95}{360}=\frac{19}{72}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{19}{72}}
\]
